en.title: Uncover the secrets of the world in the forest at night. Free trial version of 3D exploration ADV “A Tiny Wander” now available on Steam

en.title: EA plans to cut costs by $700 million per year and layoffs

It is reported that as EA has now completed its privatization, the company also needs to bear US$18 billion in debt. In order to repay approximately $1.8 billion in interest per year and ensure profits, EA will face significant cost reductions. According to Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter, cost cutting is EA's core task after completing the acquisition. EA has told bond investors that it plans to cut costs by $700 million annually, of which $170 million is "organizational efficiency optimization." In other words, mass layoffs are inevitable. It is worth mentioning that EA has been promoting employees to use artificial intelligence technology to improve productivity. EA told investors in 2025 that it hopes to use AI to assist in writing game codes and reduce operating costs.

items.title: 《周刊少年Jump》平均发行量首次低于100万册
items.summary: 日本杂志协会公布了《周刊少年Jump》4月~6月的平均发行量：98万5000万册。这是自开始公布数据以来，《周刊少年Jump》的平均发行量首次低于100万册。 集英社的《周刊少年Jump》创刊于1968年，起初为双周刊，1969年转为周刊，曾诞生过《阿拉蕾》《七龙珠》《城市猎人》《JOJO的奇妙冒险》《灌篮高手》《幽游白书》等漫画名作，为日本发行量最高的连载漫画杂志。1994年12月，该杂志的发行量创下了创刊以来的最高纪录：653万册。 根据日本杂志协会的数据，讲谈社的《周刊少年Magazine》同期的平均发行量为28万1000册、小学馆的《周刊少年Sunday》同期平均发行量为12万册。

en.title: Weekly Shonen Jump's average circulation falls below 1 million copies for the first time
en.summary: The Japan Magazine Association announced the average circulation of "Weekly Shonen Jump" from April to June: 985,000 copies. This is the first time since the data began to be released that the average circulation of "Weekly Shonen Jump" has fallen below 1 million copies. Shueisha's "Weekly Shōnen Jump" was founded in 1968. It was initially a bi-weekly magazine and became a weekly magazine in 1969. It has produced famous comic works such as "Arale", "Dragon Ball", "City Hunter", "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure", "Slam Dunk" and "Yu Yu Hakusho". It is the highest-circulating comic book magazine in Japan. In December 1994, the magazine's circulation reached a record high since its inception: 6.53 million copies. According to data from the Japan Magazine Association, Kodansha's "Weekly Shonen Magazine" had an average circulation of 281,000 copies during the same period, and Shogakukan's "Weekly Shonen Sunday" had an average circulation of 120,000 copies during the same period.

en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Kill all Starscream! (Picture/Ronaldo) I can’t be called a loyal player of business simulation games, but there are usually a lot of plants planted in such games. Generally speaking, the gameplay in simulation management and plant-related games is to plant vegetables, flowers, and trees, water them on time, and wait a few days, and a batch of neat things will grow in the ground. In reality, I also like plants. But I don’t like planting flowers that much. This is because I can’t stand a plant that doesn’t grow well for more than half a year, just to wait for a short flowering period. In comparison, buying fresh cut flowers is much easier. I also prefer to spend dozens of dollars to buy a few bunches of peonies, put them in a vase, and watch them bloom into their most beautiful flowers within a few days, and then throw them away. Water lilies are also beautiful, but none of the water lilies I bought in recent times have bloomed. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but fresh cut flowers always give me a sense of joy.

I started chatting with these people who were coming to the event without buying tickets. Acker stood in the crowd of people who didn't get tickets. From time to time, he took out his mobile phone and raised it above his head, trying to capture the anchors who were signing autographs for fans. Ake is from Jiangsu. items.summary: 父親が子の受胎前に経験した感染症は、精子を通じて子の脳や行動に影響する可能性があります。オーストラリアのフローリー神経科学・精神衛生研究所のエリザベス・クレーマン氏やアンソニー・ハナン氏らの研究チームが、中等症から重症に当たる新型コロナウイルス感染を経験したオスのマウスを使い、感染後に生まれた子への影響を調べました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 严重的新冠病毒可能通过精子影响后代的焦虑倾向
zh.summary: 父亲在孩子受孕前经历的感染会通过精子影响孩子的大脑和行为。澳大利亚弗洛里神经科学与心理健康研究所的伊丽莎白·克莱曼（Elizabeth Kleman）和安东尼·汉南（Anthony Hannan）领导的研究小组使用经历过中度至重度感染新冠病毒的雄性小鼠来研究感染后对出生后代的影响。阅读更多...

en.title: Severe new coronavirus may affect anxiety tendencies in offspring through sperm
en.summary: Infections experienced by the father before the child's conception can affect the child's brain and behavior through the sperm. A research team led by Elizabeth Kleman and Anthony Hannan of the Florey Institute of Neuroscience and Mental Health in Australia used male mice that had experienced moderate to severe infection with the new coronavirus to examine the effects on offspring born after infection. read more...

items.title: 人類が太陽系を決して離れることができない「何もない空間」という最大の壁とは？
items.summary: 宇宙は果てしなく広く、宇宙開発が始まって50年以上たっても、人類はまだ宇宙のごく一部しか観測できていません。太陽系の外へ人類が本格的に進出できない理由について、教育系YouTubeチャンネルのKurzgesagtがムービーで解説しています。続きを読む...

zh.title: 阻止人类离开太阳系的最大的“真空”墙是什么？
zh.summary: 宇宙无限广阔，太空探索五十多年了，人类仍然只能观测到宇宙的一小部分。 YouTube 教育频道 Kurzgesagt 在一部电影中解释了为什么人类无法完全走出太阳系。阅读更多...

en.title: What is the biggest wall of "empty space" that prevents humanity from leaving the solar system?
en.summary: The universe is infinitely vast, and even after more than 50 years since space exploration began, humans have still only been able to observe a small portion of the universe. Kurzgesagt, an educational YouTube channel, explains in a movie why humans cannot fully advance outside the solar system. read more...

items.title: 100分の1の価格のオープンモデルでGPT-5.6 Solの検索性能を凌駕したという報告
items.summary: サーバーレスなPostgresデータベースを提供しているNeonが、オープンソースAIモデルを企業向けに追加学習するための基盤を提供する企業のCastformと共同で、40億パラメータのオープンソースモデルを強化学習でポストトレーニングしたことにより「検索タスクにおいてOpenAIのGPT-5.6 Solと同等の精度を100分の1のコストで達成した」と報告しました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 报告称，价格仅为 1/100 的开放模型优于 GPT-5.6 Sol 的搜索性能
zh.summary: Neon 提供无服务器 Postgres 数据库，它与 Castform（一家为企业提供开源 AI 模型额外学习平台的公司）合作，使用强化学习对 40 亿参数的开源模型进行后训练。他们报告称，他们“在搜索任务中达到了相当于 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 的精度，而成本却只有 OpenAI 的 1/100。”阅读更多...

en.title: Report that an open model at 1/100th the price outperforms GPT-5.6 Sol's search performance
en.summary: Neon, which provides a serverless Postgres database, collaborated with Castform, a company that provides a platform for additional learning of open source AI models for enterprises, to post-train a 4 billion parameter open source model using reinforcement learning. They reported that they achieved ``accuracy equivalent to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol in search tasks at 1/100th the cost.'' read more...

items.title: 機能を絞ったAIコーディングツール「Pi」が高性能な理由とは？4つの基本機能でAIコストを抑える仕組み
items.summary: AIにコードの修正やコマンド実行を任せるコーディングハーネス「Pi」は、標準機能を意図的に絞り込むことで処理費用と作業効率の改善を目指しています。Databricksによる性能検証やShopifyで開発された拡張機能の事例から、単純な設計が強みになる理由をPiの開発元であるEARENDILが説明しています。続きを読む...

zh.title: AI编码工具“Pi”性能高但功能有限的原因是什么？具有四个基本功能的降低人工智能成本的机制
zh.summary: Pi是一种让人工智能修改代码和执行命令的编码工具，旨在通过有意缩小标准功能来提高处理成本和工作效率。 Pi 的开发者 EARENDIL 使用 Databricks 的性能验证示例和 Shopify 开发的扩展解释了为什么简单的设计是一种优势。阅读更多...

en.title: What is the reason for the high performance of the AI ​​coding tool “Pi” with limited functions? A mechanism to reduce AI costs with four basic functions
en.summary: Pi, a coding harness that lets AI modify code and execute commands, aims to improve processing costs and work efficiency by intentionally narrowing down standard functions. EARENDIL, the developer of Pi, explains why a simple design is a strength, using examples of performance verification with Databricks and extensions developed with Shopify. read more...

items.title: アメリカ12州の水道施設がサイバー攻撃の標的に、イランによるインフラ攻撃の疑い
items.summary: アメリカ各地で浄水場や下水処理施設などの水道インフラを狙ったサイバー攻撃が相次いで報告されています。少なくとも12州で侵入事案が確認されており、連邦捜査局(FBI)や国土安全保障省傘下のサイバーセキュリティ・社会基盤安全保障庁(CISA)などが調査を進めています。続きを読む...

zh.title: 美国12州供水设施遭网络攻击 疑为伊朗基础设施攻击
zh.summary: 美国各地接连报道针对净水厂、污水处理设施等水利基础设施的网络攻击。至少有 12 个州已确认遭到入侵，联邦调查局 (FBI) 和国土安全部下属的网络安全和基础设施安全局 (CISA) 正在调查。阅读更多...

en.title: Water facilities in 12 U.S. states targeted in cyberattacks, suspected of infrastructure attack by Iran
en.summary: Cyber ​​attacks targeting water infrastructure such as water purification plants and sewage treatment facilities have been reported one after another across the United States. Intrusions have been confirmed in at least 12 states, and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) under the Department of Homeland Security are investigating. read more...

items.title: AI検索はGoogle検索を置き換えるのではなく新たな顧客を呼び込んでいるとShopifyが報告
items.summary: ブラウザ検索をする代わりにチャットAIに尋ねることで知りたいことの解説や必要な情報を得られることから、「Google検索からウェブサイトへの流入が減少する」という懸念が広がっています。一方で、eコマースプラットフォームを運営するShopifyは、「AI検索はGoogle検索を置き換えるものではなく、新たな顧客を呼び込む新しい流入経路になっている」との見方を決算発表会で示しました。続きを読む...

zh.title: Shopify 报告称，人工智能搜索正在吸引新客户，而不是取代谷歌搜索
zh.summary: 人们越来越担心“通过谷歌搜索进入网站的流量将会减少”，因为你可以通过询问聊天人工智能而不是进行浏览器搜索来获得有关你想知道的内容的解释和必要信息。另一方面，运营电子商务平台的Shopify在其财务业绩发布会上表示，“AI搜索并没有取代谷歌搜索，而是正在成为吸引新客户的新流入途径。”阅读更多...

en.title: Shopify reports that AI search is attracting new customers rather than replacing Google search
en.summary: There is a growing concern that ``the inflow to websites from Google search will decrease'' because you can get explanations and necessary information about what you want to know by asking chat AI instead of doing a browser search. On the other hand, Shopify, which operates an e-commerce platform, stated at its financial results presentation that ``AI search is not replacing Google search, but is becoming a new inflow route to attract new customers.'' read more...

en.summary: The blockbuster movie "Toy Story 5", which has been in theaters since July 3, 2026, has achieved box office revenue of over 10 billion yen in 34 days, the fastest ever for a Pixar animation film. The highest grossing series of all time was Toy Story 3 with 10.8 billion yen, and the record is about to be broken. read more...

items.title: 地球に優しい食事は細胞老化を遅らせて脳を保護する可能性
items.summary: 主に植物性食品(全粒穀物、果物、野菜など)と少量の動物性食品を食べることで、人間の健康を守ると同時に環境保護を行うという食事法「プラネタリーヘルスダイエット」が研究機関から提唱されています。この食事法が脳に与える影響について調査した新たな研究結果が公開されました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 地球友好型饮食可以减缓细胞衰老并保护大脑
zh.summary: 研究机构提出了“地球健康饮食”，即以植物性食品（全谷物、水果、蔬菜等）为主，少量动物性食品，保护人类健康、保护环境的饮食方法。一项新的研究已经发表，调查这种饮食对大脑的影响。阅读更多...

en.title: Earth-friendly diet may slow cellular aging and protect the brain
en.summary: Research institutes have proposed the ``Planetary Health Diet,'' a dietary method that protects human health and protects the environment by eating mainly plant foods (whole grains, fruits, vegetables, etc.) and small amounts of animal foods. A new study has been published investigating the effects of this diet on the brain. read more...
